fact: An AI-based One Health surveillance platform piloted March to September 2025 in Saint-Louis, Dakar and Kedougou detected Rift Valley fever early-warning signals days to weeks before official confirmation, and issued 330 alerts of which 144 were confirmed in the pilot sites Podor, Kedougou and Pikine.
title: Artificial intelligence-supported One Health surveillance for early warning of Rift Valley fever in Senegal
